item.title: West Bridgford St Giles’ Church Christmas Tree Festival – Friday and all weekend
item.description: The West Bridgford Christmas Tree Festival is supporting local rough sleepers and vulnerable adults through donations to see over 30 specially-decorated entries from community groups in the local area. item.title: Police statement after woman found injured in Keyworth
item.description: Police investigating the discovery of an injured woman in Keyworth aren’t currently treating the incident as suspicious. Emergency services attended Westerdale Drive, around 4.30pm yesterday, after a woman was found lying in the street. item.title: Appeal after burglary at a Hockley shop
item.description: Police are appealing for information after a Nottingham shop was burgled. Cash from inside a till was stolen from K-Pop Korner, in Heathcoat Street, Hockley. A window above the shop door was smashed during the break in, which was reported at 7am on Wednesday (3 December). Officers are carrying out CCTV enquiries and forensic analysis […]
